change.description: Load each planar-qmicro Q6 selected-down quartet's four aligned FP16 d coefficients with one uint64 and its four signed int8 scales with one uint32 while preserving Q6 reconstruction, F32 multiply association, four-wave reduction, BF16 stores, and slot-order weighted output.

leaf.scope: actual Q6 layer-1 E256/K1024/N3072/top10 selected-down plus fused weighting
leaf.protocol: 21 counterbalanced samples x 100 launches after 5 warmups
leaf.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_selected_natural_decode_leaf.py --down-candidate q6-paircoeff-weighted --warmups 5 --samples 21 --burst 100 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-q6-selected-down-paircoeff-leaf.json

trace.candidate_specialization: qk_t16_selected_natural_gemv_kernel<unsigned short, 6, true, true, true, true, true>

resident_gate.workload: p512/d128 eager c=1, matrix rows 2048, attention rows 128
resident_gate.protocol: seven counterbalanced control/candidate pairs in one resident session; model load excluded
resident_gate.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 7 --warmup-rows 128 --compare-selected-down-q6-paircoeff-weighted-decode --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-p512-d128-q6-down-paircoeff-sevenpair.json

source_audit.finding: The comparator publishes Q8_1 activation blocks with broad per-block workgroups and excludes Q6_K from AMD MMVQ; it does not supply evidence for a Q6 selected-vector coefficient transport win. Its larger advantage is grouped work ownership plus cached packed activations and command-buffer submission.

decision.reason: The exact 6.30% Q6 leaf improvement and VGPR contraction do not shorten the complete two-queue token wall; the same-resident gate regresses median throughput and wins only two of seven pairs.
